en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large Renaissance-style weighing house building with ornate gables and dormer windows, situated on a town square. A broad exterior staircase leads up to an entrance on the left side of the facade. Surrounding the building are narrow European townhouses and shops; a horse-drawn cart and pedestrians are visible in the square. In the upper left corner, printed text reads "Nijmegen De Waag."
